lines.en: label rikaspecial2:
scene rikaschool1
: Okay. What are you scheming today?
lines.zh: : 好。你今天又在密谋什么?

lines.en: : Senpai! You say that as if I have a history of scheming. And I’ve been almost entirely scheme-free the whole time you’ve known me.
lines.zh: : 学姐!你说得好像我有密谋前科似的。自我认识你以来,我几乎全程清白。

lines.en: : Almost implies that there has been at least one. And that face is leading me to believe I am currently in the midst of it. So...out with it, subordinate.
lines.zh: : 「几乎」意味着至少有一次。而你这副表情让我确信:我正身处其中。所以……从实招来,下属。

lines.en: scene rikaschool2
: Hey! All that “subordinate” stuff really hurts, you know! I do just as much around here as you! You’d be nowhere without me.
lines.zh: : 喂!「下属」这一套真的很伤人诶!我在这边干的活可不比你少!没有我你哪儿都去不了!

lines.en: : That’s probably true. Things would definitely be a lot quieter, though.
lines.zh: : 这大概是真的。不过,事情绝对会安静很多。

lines.en: scene rikaschool3
: Apology accepted.
lines.zh: : 道歉我收下了。

lines.en: There was no apology.
lines.zh: : 根本就没有道歉。

lines.en: : To show your forgiveness, I will allow you to take me out to a fancy restaurant of your choice where I will proceed to-
lines.zh: : 为了展示你的宽宏大量,我将允许你带我去一家你自选的高级餐厅,然后我将——

lines.en: : That is not what you came here for. Tell me what you want.
lines.zh: : 那不是你来这里的目的。说吧,你想要什么。

lines.en: scene rikaschool4
: Some respect would be nice.
lines.zh: : 一点点尊重就很好。

lines.en: : Anything else?
lines.zh: : 还有别的吗?

lines.en: scene rikaschool5
: Yeah. I have a secret for you.
lines.zh: : 有。我有个秘密要告诉你。

lines.en: : To be honest, things are about to get really crazy up in here, Sensei. You might wanna buckle up for this one.
lines.zh: : 说实话,Sensei,这里马上就要变得超级疯狂了。这一条你最好系好安全带。

lines.en: : Uh-oh. Is today the day we finally cross the line of boss and semi-useful employee and wind up sleeping together on the couch?
lines.zh: : 哦不。难道今天就是我们终于跨越「老板与半有用员工」的界线、在沙发上睡到一起的日子?

lines.en: scene rikaschool6
: No! And for the millionth time, you are not my boss! I report only to those at the top of the educational ladder and I will not be reduced to mere nothingness by a man who can barely climb it!
lines.zh: : 不!而且第一百万次声明:你不是我老板!我只向教育体系的顶层汇报,我才不会被一个连梯子都爬不上去的男人贬为尘埃!

lines.en: : Sorry, can’t hear you from all the way above you on some ladder-thing.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,我在这架什么梯子上离你太远的地方,听不见。

lines.en: : Newest employee of Kumon-mi High! Please enter the room!
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 高中最新的教职员工!请进!

lines.en: : Newest employee?
lines.zh: : 最新的教职员工?

lines.en: scene rikaschool7
: Ta-dah!
lines.zh: : 铛铛!

lines.en: : Hey. I’m here now.
lines.zh: : 嗨。我来了。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : Please give a warm welcome to the new light music club advisor, Rika Rokuhara!
lines.zh: : 请热烈欢迎新任轻音部顾问,Rika Rokuhara!

lines.en: : You’re...a teacher now?
lines.zh: : 你……当老师了?

lines.en: scene rikaschool8
: I hope not. I never even finished high school. I’m kind of just here to chaperone Rin’s band.
lines.zh: : 我希望不是。我连高中都没念完。我来这里基本就是为了照看 Rin 的乐队。

lines.en: : And to refrain from nepotism by addressing them as the light music club and not “Rin’s band.”
lines.zh: : 以及,为了避嫌裙带关系,要称呼她们为「轻音部」,而不是「Rin 的乐队」。

lines.en: : There was a job listing for just advising a club? You don’t have to, like...you know, teach as well?
lines.zh: : 还有「只当社团顾问」这种职位招聘?你不用……你知道的,顺便教课吗?

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯,大概。

lines.en: : What the fuck? I want that job.
lines.zh: : 什么鬼?我也想要那份工作。

lines.en: scene rikaschool9
: I mean...you kind of already have it, Senpai. You’re just not really good at that part either if what I’ve heard from the manga club is true.
lines.zh: : 呃……学姐,那份工作你基本已经有了。只是,如果我从漫画社听来的属实,「教课」那一部分你干得也不怎么样。

lines.en: : Stop talking to the girls in my club. Go hang out with your own.
lines.zh: : 别和我社团的女生们聊天。去找你自己的社团玩。

lines.en: : No can do, buddy. I need to hang on to every last bit of youth I’m able to wrap my hands around.
lines.zh: : 办不到,伙计。我需要抓住我能抓住的每一丝青春。

lines.en: : Ignoring the slow disintegration of your psyche and how unhealthy your desire to be young again is, why are you making a show out of this? Rika could have just come in here without you.
lines.zh: : 先不谈你精神世界的缓慢崩解、和你「重返年轻」的病态渴望——你为什么要把这件事搞成一场表演?Rika 自己进来不就行了。

lines.en: scene rikaschool10
: Because, jerk, you never answer your emails.
lines.zh: : 因为,混蛋,你从来不回邮件。

lines.en: : I have emails?
lines.zh: : 我有邮件?

lines.en: : How do you still work here?
lines.zh: : 你怎么还在这里上班的?

lines.en: : Probably tenure. I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 大概是终身教职吧。我不太确定。

lines.en: scene rikaschool11
: Hah...regardless, I’m here to save the day once again and let you know that it’s your responsibility to show Rika the ropes.
lines.zh: : 哈……不管怎样,我是来再度拯救世界的,顺便通知你:带 Rika 熟悉环境是你的职责。

lines.en: : I would have gladly done it, but the two of us have history.
lines.zh: : 我本来乐意效劳,但我们俩有一段「历史」。

lines.en: : I’m surprised you have enough pride left to bring that “history” up.
lines.zh: : 你居然还剩下足够的自尊,敢提那段「历史」,我挺意外的。

lines.en: scene rikaschool12
: I must have been drunk. Either that or Rika just doesn’t have much experience when it comes to tonsil hockey.
lines.zh: : 我当时一定是喝多了。要么就是 Rika 在「舌吻运动」方面缺乏经验。

lines.en: : No comment.
lines.zh: : 不予置评。

lines.en: : So I just have to show her the ropes?
lines.zh: : 所以我只要带她熟悉环境就行?

lines.en: scene rikaschool13
: Yeah. Think you can handle it?
lines.zh: : 对。你觉得你应付得来吗?

lines.en: : Of course. Shouldn’t be a problem at all.
lines.zh: : 当然。完全不是问题。

lines.en: scene black
scene rikaschool14
: Alright. Here they are.
lines.zh: : 好。就是这些。

lines.en: : Cool. Thanks for showing me.
lines.zh: : 酷。谢谢你带我参观。

lines.en: scene black
scene rikaschool15
: So, now what?
lines.zh: : 那么,接下来呢?

lines.en: : I’m not really sure. In fact, I barely even know what I’m supposed to be doing here.
lines.zh: : 我也不太确定。事实上,我甚至不太清楚我在这该干什么。

lines.en: : How did your orientation thingy go? Maybe you can just try and do that to me? Or...with me?
lines.zh: : 你的入职培训怎么样?也许你可以直接对我演练一遍?或者……和我一起?

lines.en: : On me?
scene rikaschool16
: Orientation...
lines.zh: : 入职培训……

lines.en: Come to think of it...I never had anything like that.
lines.zh: : 细想起来……我从来没有过那种东西。

lines.en: Sure, that’s most likely because I was thrust into this new (But confusingly not new) life in the middle of the school year where everyone already knew who I was and how I taught-
lines.zh: : 当然,那多半是因为我是在学年中途被扔进这段新的(但诡异的是又不算新)人生的——所有人都已经知道我是谁、我怎么教课——

lines.en: But that doesn’t take away from how confusing I know things must be for Rika right now. And how most other people in her shoes would just abuse their power to consensually molest a bunch of girls.
lines.zh: : 但这不能减轻我知道 Rika 现在有多迷茫。以及换了大多数人,恐怕早就滥用手中的权力、征得同意地骚扰一群女孩了。

lines.en: Actually, that’s probably just me and a handful of other horrible individuals who shouldn’t be allowed in a place like this. But I should ask just to make sure.
lines.zh: : 其实,大概只有我和一小撮其他不该被允许出现在这种地方的人渣才会那样。但我应该问一下确认。

lines.en: : How interested are you in pursuing a physical relationship with teenage girls?
lines.zh: : 你对和未成年女孩发展肉体关系有多大兴趣?

lines.en: : Like...in phys-ed? I can probably teach phys-ed if I have to. That wasn’t in the job description, but how hard could it possibly be?
lines.zh: : 你是说……体育课?真需要的话我大概能教体育。职位描述里没写,但那能有多难?

lines.en: Okay, so it seems like that sort of thing doesn’t even occur to Rika and I really am just the scum of the earth. That’s good.
lines.zh: : 好,看来这种事根本不会在 Rika 的脑内发生,而我的确就是人渣本渣。这很好。

lines.en: But I should probably at least show her around so she doesn’t get lost and wind up like Yasu — desperately clinging to those she trusts and leaving her well-being entirely in their hands.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概至少该带她转转,免得她迷路、落得和 Yasu 一样——死死抓住自己信任的人,把自身的安危全部交到对方手里。

lines.en: : I don’t think you’ll have to teach phys-ed. The girls normally just hang out on their phones for that period. But I can give you a tour at least.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不用教体育。那个时段女孩们一般就窝着刷手机。不过至少我可以带你转转。

lines.en: scene rikaschool17
: Cool. Works for me.
lines.zh: : 酷。正合我意。

lines.en: : I know we’re friends outside of work and whatnot, but I kind of need this job thing to go well so I can finally get out of Rin’s hair.
lines.zh: : 我知道我们私下是朋友什么的,但这份工作对我很关键——我好终于别再赖在 Rin 那里。

lines.en: : I’m sure I don’t have to tell you this since you’re already familiar with the place, but let’s keep it professional while we’re here. Cool?
lines.zh: : 这话不用我说你也明白,毕竟这地方你已经熟门熟路;但我们在工作时间还是保持专业。行吗?

lines.en: : Yeah...I don’t know if I can do that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不确定我能不能做到。

lines.en: scene rikaschool18
: Why? Do you have a crush on me?
lines.zh: : 为什么?你暗恋我?

lines.en: : Why are your first assumptions for things always so strange?
lines.zh: : 你的第一反应为什么总是这么奇怪?

lines.en: : Is that strange? Because I don’t think I’ve ever had a job where my boss didn’t immediately try to hook up with me before, so I’m kind of just used to it by now.
lines.zh: : 怪吗?我之前的工作里,老板第一天就想跟我上床的,一次都没落下过,所以我到现在已经习惯了。

lines.en: : And how many times-
lines.zh: : 那有多少——

lines.en: : No comment.
lines.zh: : 不予置评。

lines.en: scene rikaschool19
: I’m kidding.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。

lines.en: : Well, kind of.
lines.zh: : 好吧,算是半开玩笑。

lines.en: : The boss thing is true, but I haven’t really had many jobs in the first place so the numbers probably aren’t all that impressive or whatever.
lines.zh: : 老板那部分是真的,但我本来也没打过几份工,所以数字上大概没那么惊人什么的。

lines.en: : Why don’t we start with the gym?
lines.zh: : 不如先从健身房开始?

lines.en: scene black
For the next half-hour or so, I walk Rika around the school- pointing out the various rooms and offices she’ll probably have to familiarize herself with in the coming weeks.
lines.zh: : 接下来的半小时左右,我带着 Rika 在学校里转——指出她接下来几周大概需要熟悉的各个教室和办公室。

lines.en: But, to be honest, I have no idea if this will be valuable at all as I did not imagine the school would ever stoop to hiring someone for just one thing as the rest of us follow our classes everywhere.
lines.zh: : 但说实话,我不确定这到底有没有价值——我根本没想过这所学校会沦落到雇一个人只干一件事,毕竟我们其他人都是跟着自己的班级到处跑的。

lines.en: Well, almost everywhere.
lines.zh: : 嗯,几乎到处跑。

lines.en: I’ve yet to make my way inside of the shower room in the gym yet, but I did come close that one time when Nodoka decided to try and ruin Yumi’s life.
lines.zh: : 健身房的淋浴间我还没进去过,但有一次差点就进了——那次是 Nodoka 决定要毁掉 Yumi 的人生。

lines.en: Nodoka.
lines.zh: : Nodoka。

lines.en: scene nodokascene35sepia
I keep forgetting what happened — but in different ways from how I normally forget.
lines.zh: : 我一直在忘记发生过的事——但忘记的方式,和我平时的不一样。

lines.en: That night in the hotel is all still a blur, but there’s something inside of me I cannot identify that doesn’t make me uncomfortable with it.
lines.zh: : 酒店的那一夜至今仍是一团模糊,但我体内有一种我无法辨认的东西,让我对此并不感到不适。

lines.en: If anything, it makes me feel good.
lines.zh: : 甚至,它让我感觉良好。

lines.en: The lingering satisfaction of unsheathing my cock from her virgin hole vaporizes the resentment and disdain I know I’m meant to have over what she’s done to Yumi and...anyone else she’s toyed with.
lines.zh: : 从她那未经人事的洞里拔出我的东西时,那份挥之不去的满足,蒸发了本该涌上心头的怨恨与鄙夷——为她对 Yumi 做的事,以及……她玩弄过的其他任何人。

lines.en: So basically...all of us.
lines.zh: : 所以基本上……我们所有人。

lines.en: But I can’t bring myself to hate her.
lines.zh: : 但我没办法恨她。

lines.en: I can’t even bring myself to dislike her.
lines.zh: : 我甚至连讨厌她都做不到。

lines.en: All I can think of is how safe she makes me feel.
lines.zh: : 我满脑子只剩她给我的那种安全感。

lines.en: Or perhaps it would be better described as numbness.
lines.zh: : 或者,更准确的说法也许是麻木。

lines.en: I want to feel it again.
lines.zh: : 我想再感受一次。

lines.en: I want to devour her.
lines.zh: : 我想把她吞吃入腹。

lines.en: : Helloooo? Anyone home?
lines.zh: : 喂————?有人在家吗?

lines.en: scene rikaschool20
: Huh? What?
lines.zh: : 咦?什么?

lines.en: : Caught you staring off into the distance. But I guess we can just chalk it up to you being a goober again.
lines.zh: : 抓到你了,又在望天发呆。不过我猜,这又可以归功于你是个傻鹅。

lines.en: : I don’t like whatever sort of “vibe” we’re creating here —which I’m pretty sure is what relationship dynamics are referred to as by young people now.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢我们之间正在形成的这种「氛围」——我相当确定,现在的年轻人管「关系动态」就叫这个。

lines.en: : Really? I think we mesh kinda well. But I’m saying that as professional Rika — not “make out with coworkers at a dive bar” Rika.
lines.zh: : 真的吗?我觉得我们挺合拍的。不过我是以「职业 Rika」的身份说的——不是「在破酒吧里和同事接吻」的 Rika。

lines.en: : As long as I’m next and not Wakana I’ll be happy.
lines.zh: : 只要下一个不是我之前那位 Wakana,我就心满意足。

lines.en: scene rikaschool21
: See?! I told you. Every single boss I’ve ever had has tried to get into my pants on day one. I can’t escape.
lines.zh: : 看?!我就说吧。我遇过的每一个老板,第一天就想钻进我裤子里。我逃不掉。

lines.en: : I mean, if you want to get technical, I was trying to get into your mouth.
lines.zh: : 严格来说,我想钻进去的是你的嘴。

lines.en: : That’s easier, but still. Come on, man. I’m too old to hang out under the bleachers at this point in life. I’m just trying to make some money so Rin doesn’t have to do my laundry anymore.
lines.zh: : 那倒是容易点。但还是很过分,伙计。到了人生这个阶段,我太老了,不适合再钻看台底下了。我只是想赚点钱,让 Rin 不用再给我洗衣服。

lines.en: scene rikaschool22
: Wait! Are we allowed to do our laundry here? Does the teacher’s lounge have a bed? Also, why is there a boy’s locker room? This is an all-girl school.
lines.zh: : 等等!我们可以在这里洗衣服吗?教员休息室有床吗?另外,为什么有个男生更衣室?这是女校吧。

lines.en: : No, no, and no clue. And before you ask, you can’t live here.
lines.zh: : 不行、不行、不知道。先回答你接下来的问题:不能住在这里。

lines.en: scene rikaschool23
: Not even for, like...a weekend so Rin and Otoha can make out on her bed?
lines.zh: : 那……为了一个周末也不行吗?好让 Rin 和 Otoha 在床上亲热?

lines.en: scene rikaschool24
: Rika! What are you doing here? And what were you just saying about Rin and me?
lines.zh: : Rika!你在这里干什么?你刚才在说我和 Rin 什么?

lines.en: : I work here now! I’m your new club advisor thing!
lines.zh: : 我在这里上班了!我是你的新社团顾问什么的!

lines.en: scene rikaschool25
: Wait, seriously? Like, you officially work here? That’s awesome.
lines.zh: : 等等,真的?就是说,你正式在这里上班了?太棒了。

lines.en: : It is! But do you know what’s even more awesome? The fact that you and Rin are sexually active n-
lines.zh: : 是很棒!但你知道更棒的是什么吗?你和 Rin 已经有了性生活这——

lines.en: scene rikaschool26
: Wow.
scene rikaschool27
: Otoha! Come back! I just wanted to congratulate you guys!
lines.zh: : Otoha!回来!我只是想恭喜你们!

lines.en: : Rika, I get that you’re kind of...and forgive me for lack of a better term...a goober-
lines.zh: : Rika,我理解你这个人有点……请原谅我找不到更好的措辞……傻鹅——

lines.en: : But there are some things you just shouldn’t say to your daughter’s significant other and almost all of them are exactly what you just said.
lines.zh: : 但有些话是绝对不该对女儿的对象说的,而你刚才说的,几乎句句都在其列。

lines.en: scene rikaschool28
: Damn it. I thought girls today were more open about that kind of stuff?
lines.zh: : 搞什么。我以为现在的女孩对这种事更开放了?

lines.en: : Ignoring any thoughts or experience I have regarding that, I don’t think it really changes a girl not wanting to talk to her girlfriend’s mother about how many fingers she put inside of her daughter.
lines.zh: : 先不管我对那方面的想法或经验——我认为这改变不了一个女孩不愿意和自己女友的妈妈聊「你往我女儿身体里塞了几根手指」的事实。

lines.en: scene rikaschool29
: I just wanted to express my appreciation. You have any idea how long Rin’s been hormonal for?
lines.zh: : 我只是想表达感激。你知道 Rin 荷尔蒙过剩多久了吗?

lines.en: : Because that girl’s been spending way too long in the shower ever since she turned twelve and as someone who experienced that same burst of energy at that age, I know what's really going on in there.
lines.zh: : 那孩子从十二岁起,洗澡的时间就长得离谱;而我作为一个在同样年纪经历过同样能量爆发的人,我很清楚那里面真正发生着什么。

lines.en: : And that is...just one more thing a parent should just never reveal to anyone. So I am going to do my best to keep that little factoid away from Rin for the indefinite future.
lines.zh: : 而这……恰好又是一件家长永远不该向任何人透露的事。所以我会竭尽全力,在无限期的未来里,把这个小知识瞒住 Rin。

lines.en: scene rikaschool30
: Oh, come on. She’s a kid. It’s not like I’m telling you about a grown woman’s habits. I bet you were the same exact way when you were that age.
lines.zh: : 哦,拜托。她是个孩子。又不是我在跟你讲什么成年女性的习惯。我打赌你在那个年纪也是一模一样。

lines.en: : Maybe just...try to have a little more tact in the future.
lines.zh: : 也许你以后……可以稍微学一学分寸。

lines.en: scene rikaschool31
: What future? I’m 42.
lines.zh: : 什么未来?我都 42 了。

lines.en: : And even if I look okay for my age, no one’s going to stick around when they find that out.
lines.zh: : 就算我保养得看着还行,人家一知道我的年纪,也没有人会留下来。

lines.en: : People want families and whatnot and my time’s kind of limited, you know?
lines.zh: : 大家都想要家庭什么的,而我的时间……你知道的,有限。

lines.en: : Tact or no tact, it’s not gonna make a difference. So why not just “mom” it up while I still can?
lines.zh: : 有没有分寸都一样,不会有什么区别。所以我为什么不在还能「当妈」的时候,使劲当妈?

lines.en: : First off, you’re wrong and you have plenty of time left. Second, you can still “mom” it up and embarrass your daughter while keeping things like that a secret. And third-
lines.zh: : 首先,你错了,你剩下的时间多得是。第二,你完全可以继续「当妈」、继续让你女儿尴尬,同时把那些事保密。第三——

lines.en: : Is third something about how I’m a catch even with all of my “flaws?”
lines.zh: : 第三是不是「尽管有这些『缺点』,我依然抢手」?

lines.en: scene rikaschool32
: Heh...
: You know, everybody always likes to say things like that.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,大家总喜欢说那种话。

lines.en: : About how “perfection” isn’t real and that it’s those little “imperfections” that make us beautiful.
lines.zh: : 什么「完美」并不存在、正是那些小「不完美」让我们美丽。

lines.en: scene rikaschool33
: And while that sounds nice and all...and makes us look like better people than we actually are, it’s all fake at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 听起来很美……也显得我们比实际更高尚,但归根结底,全是假的。

lines.en: : Imperfections and flaws can be cute when they come in small doses, sure. But when you start paying close attention to little things like that, you don’t see “cute” at all.
lines.zh: : 小剂量的不完美和缺点,当然可以很可爱。可一旦你开始近距离盯着那些小事,你看到的就不再是「可爱」。

lines.en: : You see flaws as exactly what they are. Flaws. Flaws that pile up and weigh down how much you care about someone.
lines.zh: : 你看到的,就是缺点的本来面目。缺点。它们不断堆积,一点点压低你对一个人的在乎。

lines.en: : If it’s one or two things, you can learn to deal with it.
lines.zh: : 要是只有一两件,你还可以学着接受。

lines.en: : But then you start looking for more. And they start getting easier to find.
lines.zh: : 但随后你开始寻找更多。而它们开始变得越来越容易被发现。

lines.en: scene rikaschool34
: Then, the next thing you know, you've collected so many of those “imperfections” that it becomes almost impossible to see anything good at all.
lines.zh: : 然后,不知不觉,你已经收集了太多那种「不完美」,以至于几乎看不见任何好的东西了。

lines.en: : No one has to be perfect, Rika.
lines.zh: : 没有人必须完美,Rika。

lines.en: : I agree. No one has to be perfect. No one can be perfect. Which is why we fall for people who ignore our flaws. And hey, for some, that kind of thing works out.
lines.zh: : 同意。没有人必须完美。也没有人能完美。所以我们才会爱上那些无视我们缺点的人。而且嘿,对某些人来说,这条路走得通。

lines.en: : There are plenty of successful couples who can live like that forever. And some who cherish those little quirks for the rest of their lives.
lines.zh: : 有很多成功的情侣,一辈子都那样过。也有一些,一辈子珍惜着那些小怪癖。

lines.en: : But it’s impossible to know if you’re with someone like that beforehand.
lines.zh: : 但你没办法提前知道自己身边的是不是那种人。

lines.en: : And by the time you figure it out, it might already be too late.
lines.zh: : 而等你弄明白的时候,多半已经太迟了。

lines.en: : I see...You’re not just worried you’re not good enough-
lines.zh: : 我懂了……你不只是担心自己不够好——

lines.en: : I’m afraid of being wrong again.
lines.zh: : 我怕的是再次看错人。

lines.en: scene rikaschool35
: But, on the bright side, I’m not crying anymore. Now, it’s mostly just feeling like an idiot.
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想,我已经不哭了。现在主要只剩下觉得自己像个白痴。

lines.en: scene rikaschool36
: I wasn’t always like this, though.
lines.zh: : 但我并不一直是这样的。

lines.en: : Did you suffer some...traumatic brain injury or something?
lines.zh: : 你是不是遭遇过……创伤性脑损伤什么的?

lines.en: : No, goober. I’ve never been book-smart or anything like that. Me and school were mortal enemies.
lines.zh: : 不是,傻鹅。我从来就不是读书的料。我和学校是不共戴天的死敌。

lines.en: scene rikaschool37
: But there were three things I was great at back before I spent all of my free time feeling sorry for myself.
lines.zh: : 但在我把全部空闲时间用来顾影自怜之前,有三样东西我非常擅长。

lines.en: : Thing number one was music.
lines.zh: : 第一件,是音乐。

lines.en: : I might not be able to read it as well as a lot of famous composers and stuff, but that never really mattered to me.
lines.zh: : 我可能没法像很多著名作曲家那样识谱,但那从来无关紧要。

lines.en: : I made noise that made people feel good. Or sad. Or angry. Or whatever I wanted them to feel because I wanted to feel something too.
lines.zh: : 我制造的声音,能让人快乐。或者悲伤。或者愤怒。或者任何我想要他们感受的东西——因为我也想感受到些什么。

lines.en: : I made money doing what I loved...and now I can make money doing that again. Just in a totally uncool, corporate kind of way. But hey, if Metallica can sell out, so can I.
lines.zh: : 我靠热爱的事赚钱……现在我又可以靠它赚钱了。只不过换成了一个一点也不酷的、企业化的方式。不过嘿,Metallica 都能变节,我也可以。

lines.en: : What’s number two?
lines.zh: : 第二件呢?

lines.en: scene rikaschool38
: Protesting.
lines.zh: : 抗议。

lines.en: : Is that...a thing you can be good at?
lines.zh: : 那是……一种可以「擅长」的东西吗?

lines.en: : It got me thrown in jail a bunch of times. But like half of the shit teen Rika and company campaigned against wound up getting changed eventually, so hey. That’s a win in my book.
lines.zh: : 它让我蹲过好几次局子。但少女 Rika 和伙伴们抗争的东西,大概一半最终都被改变了。所以嘿,在我这就算赢。

lines.en: : It’s also how I met my ex.
lines.zh: : 我也是这样认识我的前任的。

lines.en: : You two protested together?
lines.zh: : 你们俩一起抗议?

lines.en: scene rikaschool39
: We were actually on opposite sides.
lines.zh: : 其实我们站在对立两边。

lines.en: : She was always really straight-laced and traditional when it came to her values. But a lot of that was due to the environment she was brought up in.
lines.zh: : 她在价值观上一直特别守旧、传统。但那很大程度是成长环境造成的。

lines.en: : I was lucky enough to come from a more progressive household who let me form my own opinions instead of guiding me toward theirs.
lines.zh: : 我则幸运地来自一个更开明的家庭——他们让我形成自己的观点,而不是把我往他们的观点上引。

lines.en: : Which was really great on account of the whole “liking girls” thing.
lines.zh: : 考虑到「喜欢女孩」这件事,这真是帮了大忙。

lines.en: : But yeah, if it weren’t for number two and number three, I never would have wound up with her in the first place.
lines.zh: : 不过总之,要不是第二件和第三件,我根本不会和她走到一起。

lines.en: : And what was number three exactly?
lines.zh: : 那第三件到底是什么?

lines.en: scene rikaschool40
: Eating pussy.
lines.zh: : 吃那个。

lines.en: : I expected nothing less from you.
lines.zh: : 果然不辜负你的名声。

lines.en: scene rikaschool41
: What can I say? Girls always like to think they’re straight until they meet someone who knows how to please them.
lines.zh: : 我能说什么呢?女孩们总以为自己直,直到遇见一个知道怎么取悦她们的人。

lines.en: : So, yeah. I’m basically the savior of humanity — a woman so skilled that she has straight up eaten the homophobia out of someone.
lines.zh: : 所以,是的。我基本上是人类的救世主——一个技术好到能把恐同直接从一个人体内吃出去的女人。

lines.en: : I’m curious as to how you got her in that position in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我好奇你当初是怎么让她进入那种位置的。

lines.en: scene rikaschool42
: I am just that good.
lines.zh: : 我就是这么厉害。

lines.en: scene rikaschool43
: But again, those days are over. I’m 100%% embarrassing mom now.
lines.zh: : 不过,那些日子结束了。我现在 100%% 是个丢人的妈妈。

lines.en: : Are you sure? Don’t you have a duty to the world you need to carry out? Not many were born with your power.
lines.zh: : 你确定?你不是对这个世界负有一份使命吗?天生拥有你这种力量的人可不多。

lines.en: : The only duty I have now is getting my life back on track and making sure Rin stays on hers.
lines.zh: : 我现在唯一的使命,是让人生重回正轨,以及确保 Rin 不脱轨。

lines.en: : Hopefully, I’ll be able to accomplish both of those by being here.
lines.zh: : 但愿待在这里,我能把两件事都办成。

lines.en: scene rikaschool44
: And maybe...
lines.zh: : 说不定……

lines.en: scene black
: Maybe, I’ll find something else as well.
lines.zh: : 说不定,我还会找到别的东西。

lines.en: : Or maybe I won’t?
lines.zh: : 又或者不会?

lines.en: : There’s art in never knowing.
lines.zh: : 永远不知道,也是一种艺术。

lines.en: : And I don’t mind appreciating that for a little longer this time.
lines.zh: : 而这一次,我不介意再欣赏它一阵子。
